description: Test suite for managing sidebar categories and channel muting in Mattermost, including creation, updating, ordering, and diffing categories and channels.

methods.name: TestSidebarCategory
methods.description: Tests creating, updating, reordering, and retrieving sidebar categories and their order.

methods.name: TestGetSidebarCategories
methods.description: Tests retrieving sidebar categories for a user and team, including migration scenarios and error handling.

methods.name: TestUpdateSidebarCategories
methods.description: Tests muting/unmuting categories and channels, moving channels between categories, and their effects on channel mute states.

methods.name: TestDiffChannelsBetweenCategories
methods.description: Tests diffing logic for detecting channel movements between categories, including no-change and move scenarios.
